e: Gendai ni okeru shikaku wo chûshin to shita bunka no kenkyû
Shôhi to yûkyô ni yoru gendai sei shônen no hikaku bunrui
Chiiki bunna shinkô no mondai ten to sono kôseki
Funsô to kasô no ika ni yoru shinri teki shôheki no shôka sayô
Jiritsu kôdô ni miru haiseki to jyuyô no kyôkai
Sabu karuchâ wo meguru tasha to no kankeiron
Taijin kankei ni okeru kôdô sentaku no tokuchô
Ryôsan gata seizô katei ni okeru hikaku kenkyu
Tokushu heisa jôkyô ka ni okeru setsumei gimu no yûmu ni tsuite
Keizai kôka kara kangaeru yoka shôhi no fechishizumu
Toshi gata hanzai ni okeru akui no shozai ron
Soshiki no sai kôchiku ji ni hassei suru kadai to taisaku
